distractor_reasons.sallow_road_well_construction_records.pd: the screens and logs describe the wells, which all draw the full saturated thickness of one sand aquifer; the forecast turns on the land over the zones, not the wells' build
distractor_reasons.corlinden_well_specific_capacity_2008-20: specific capacity bears on pumping capacity and well rehabilitation, which the plan's fixed shares already settle
distractor_reasons.ravell_county_fertilizer_sales_1990-2025: county-wide sales carry no parcel, land cover or timing; the leachate the wells receive is measured directly by the network
